title: DFT ground state calculation
action: Run Quantum ESPRESSO with the B3LYP hybrid functional on a 3×3×3 supercell (81 atoms) of cubic HfO₂ with one oxygen atom removed to obtain the ground state wavefunction and related outputs.
description: Ground‑state DFT calculation for the oxygen‑vacancy supercell.

title: Total density of states (TDOS) extraction
action: From the DFT ground state output, compute the total density of states and write tdos.dat containing energy (eV) and DOS (arbitrary units).
description: TDOS data for the oxygen‑vacancy supercell.
output_schema: Two whitespace‑separated columns: energy (float, eV), density of states (float).

title: Optical absorption spectrum extraction
action: From the DFT output, compute the optical absorption spectrum and write absorption.dat containing energy (eV) and absorption intensity (arbitrary units).
description: Optical absorption spectrum for the oxygen‑vacancy supercell.
output_schema: Two whitespace‑separated columns: energy (float, eV), absorption (float).
